[IRET.16.7] **Expression trees** are protobuf messages
with a top-level `oneof` over expression kinds; recursive
child expressions are embedded messages. This is the
standard protobuf pattern for trees; the loader
recursively constructs `ds_rete_expr_t` nodes from the
protobuf tree. A **CALL** expression (`proto/rete_expr.proto#CallExpr`) carries a
numeric `BuiltinFn` **`op`** (field 3; the former builtin-name field 1 is
`reserved`) — the loader stores the op directly on the CALL node for O(1) op
dispatch ([IRET.13]); no name is interned.
